sections.theory:
The sampling distribution of \overline{X} is given below:

(iii) Calculation for mean and S.E of the sampling distribution of \overline{X}

E(\overline{X})=\mu_{\overline{x}}=\Sigma\overline{x}f(\overline{x})=\frac{105}{15}=7

\sigma_{\overline{x}}=\sqrt{\Sigma\overline{x}^2f(\overline{x})-[\Sigma\overline{x}f(\overline{x})]^2}=\sqrt{\frac{789}{15}-\left(\frac{105}{15}\right)^2}

=\sqrt{52.6-49}=\sqrt{3.6}=1.9

Now verification of the properties:

(i) As we see that μ = 7, E(\overline{X})=7, hence proved that E(\overline{X})=\mu

(ii) In S.W.O.R case, the S.E is

$\sigma_{\overline{x}}=\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\cdot\sqrt{\frac{N-n}{N-n}}=\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{\frac{6-2}{6-1}}=\frac{3}{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{\frac{4}{5}}=1.9$

This is exactly the same as computed \sigma_{\overline{x}}.
